title: Special Public Events
heading: Special *Events*
description: Ticketed public community events at Our Little Village in Staten Island: holiday celebrations, egg hunts, Moms' Night Out and Sip & Paints.
intro: Big magic, themed fun and lasting memories. Ticketed community events all year long.

cards.title: Family Events
cards.subtitle: From big holidays to the little ones, like Mother's Day and Father's Day
cards.text: We often invite special guest vendors and unique experiences to make every celebration bigger.

bullets.text: Party games, scavenger hunts and sensory stations
The Great Egg Hunt, indoor snowball fights and festive crafts
Custom balloon installations and immersive backdrops
Visits from favorite heroes, princesses and holiday icons

cards.title: Adult Celebrations & Socials
cards.subtitle: A stylish oasis to socialize, unwind and connect
cards.text: Look out for public community socials like Moms' Night Out and creative Sip & Paints with talented guest hosts.

cards.title: How tickets work
cards.subtitle: Public events have limited capacity and sell out fast

bullets.text: All advance tickets are booked by text at 347-327-8166
Zelle, Venmo and all major credit cards
Due to high demand and limited space, public event tickets are non-refundable
Dates and ticket releases go up on Instagram first
